# AdversarialResilience

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The ability of an autonomous system to maintain functionality and performance when facing deliberate attacks, spoofing, or deceptive inputs. Drives the need for distributed, fault-tolerant in-network processing in iNEST, ensuring graceful degradation and continued operation in contested environments.
